Dire Straits - Brothers In Arms [40th Anniversary Edition, SDE Exclusive] (1985/2025) Blu-Ray Audio



This SDE exclusive blu-ray audio features Guy Fletcher’s 2023 Dolby Atmos Mix on a physical product for the first time, and exclusively a never before heard instrumental mix of the album available in immersive Dolby Atmos (created this year, by Guy Fletcher). The disc also includes the 2005 5.1 Mix of Brothers in Arms and two stereo mixes: the original CD stereo mix and the vinyl stereo mix with edited versions of some songs.

Five audio streams on the Brothers in Arms SDE exclusive blu-ray:
2022 Dolby Atmos Mix (48/24)
2022 Dolby Atmos Instrumental Mix (48/24)
2005 5.1 Mix (96/24)
1985 CD Version Stereo Mix (96/24)
1985 Vinyl Version Stereo Mix (96/24)
